purpose: Exploratory numerical closure of otherwise missing model fields using published Mathew 2020 values and explicit assumptions; not a device calibration

source.citation: Mathew, del Pino & Verhagen, Nature Nanotechnology 15, 198-202 (2020)

assumptions.mode_frequencies: omega1=2*pi*2.4 MHz and omega2=2*pi*2.9 MHz; 0.5 MHz separation is approximate
assumptions.hopping: J_m is set equal to the reported direct t2=2*pi*10 kHz only as a proxy; this is not an identified parameter equivalence
assumptions.optomechanical_couplings: g1=g2 is inferred as a symmetric effective coupling from geff=2*pi*200 kHz, cm=0.98 and |Delta|=0.35*kappa; it is not a measured single-photon g0
assumptions.detuning_sign: source Delta=omega_L-omega_c=+0.35*kappa; current working convention uses Delta=omega_c-omega_L, hence Delta=-0.35*kappa
assumptions.drive: incident powers 33.4 and 174 microW are converted to alpha_in under the standard coherent-input convention; external coupling and current E normalization remain unresolved
assumptions.uncertainty: 10 percent screening envelope, not a measured uncertainty

gate.reason: J_m, g0_1, g0_2, kappa_in and the mapping from alpha_in to the current normalized E remain assumed or unresolved.
